name: g1_climb_stairs
title: Climb stairs (walk in, then ascend 5 treads)
summary: IN PROGRESS. The G1 walks in on flat ground, settles, then steps ONTO and up a 5-tread staircase (riser 0.07, going 0.26 = 0.35 m total), shadowing a composed walk->stand->climb sequence ghost whose root_lut rises with the treads. Train==deploy terrain is FREE (put_model batches the world stair boxes into the trainer). CURRENT WALL: propulsion -- across 6 trainer levers the policy plateaus at ~2 steps; a high-imitation run survives (0 falls) but climbs no further -- it cannot hoist its mass past step 2. Not balance/timing/height. See the campaign note.

ghost.validator: WARN (T0.velocity-limits: left_knee_joint peaks 21.8 rad/s vs the URDF's 20 -- a HARDWARE-TRANSFER flag; T2.provenance: unknown/eyeballed). It was claimed PASS here in prose while ghost_validator.py said WARN on this very lut -- the verdict is now STAMPED INTO the lut and cross-checked.
ghost.notes: Composed by design_walk_climb_ghost.py: 2.0 m flat walk-in @0.40 m/s + stand + climb from ghost_stair_climb_lut.json (step-to gait, feet land on treads via 2-link IK, pelvis rides 0.68 m above the support foot, rising root). seq+hold_end, starts with a stand so from-top deploy doesn't cold-drop mid-motion. Pure-climb segment = ghost_stair_climb_lut.json.

policy.notes: wr_stair_climb1..3 are campaign checkpoints, none a verified champion (propulsion wall). Uncommitted in runs/.

baton.notes: Sequence motion (like turn) -> solo_swap when wired into BATON. World must carry the staircase geometry (train==deploy terrain).

train.notes: SEQ_TERRAIN trainer mod: height reward tracks the rising root z + terrain RSI; put_model batches the world stair boxes so terrain is train==deploy free. Vertical crane wire OFF (HARNESS_KZ=0) so the legs must climb. VERIFY frozen bundle; memory project_g1_stair_climb_campaign.

deploy.notes: Reuses the turn solo-swap plumbing (BATON_TURN_* = the generic sequence-specialist slot). Deploy is not yet a stable demo -- see the live harness ROBOT-FIRST emit fix + KZ=0 height-sink open in the campaign note.

verification.result: OPEN: plateaus at ~2 of 5 steps across every trainer lever (propulsion wall). Live deploy has a residual batched->live gap + a KZ=0 height-sink. Not demo-ready.
